Senses.Explanation: The crown of the head is the highest point of a person’s head. Tianyi Yihuai asks after the eye located there; Zhenjing Kewen and Yuanwu Keqin put blows or decisive action at the same bodily summit. The added eye and blows are distinct constructions around one location, so they do not turn the bare word into “insight” or “authority.”
